verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean shared left edge for badge, headline, subcopy and CTA, but the 'Night Cream' headline and especially the subcopy are undersized for the canvas. The NEW badge is cut loose from the jar it overlapped in the original, and the big vertical gaps make the text column look sparse. B is worse: the CTA is offset right and doesn't line up with the headline/subcopy edge, and the NEW badge floats alone in the top-right corner. The headline, subcopy and button are spaced unevenly with large gaps, so the copy block falls apart and looks arbitrary.
